introduction: In Uttar Pradesh, marriage registrations are facilitated by the Stamp and Registration Department online via the IGRSUP portal. Aadhaar-based verification is tightly integrated, reducing manual paperwork significantly.
quickFacts:
Important Quick Facts
  • State: Uttar Pradesh
  • Department: Stamp and Registration Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
  • Portal: igrsup.gov.in
  • Process Type: Online application initiation, fee payment, and slot booking, followed by a mandatory physical visit to the Sub-Registrar Office.
  • Age Eligibility: Groom must be at least 21 years old, and bride must be at least 18 years old.
documentsRequired:
Documents Required for Marriage Registration

Note: You need soft copies of these documents for online upload (in specified formats/sizes) and the originals plus self-attested photocopies for the mandatory Sub-Registrar Office (SRO) visit.
For Groom & Bride (Uploads)
  • Photograph: Recent passport size color photo (Max 40 KB, JPEG).
  • Age Proof (Max 70 KB PDF): Highschool/SSC Certificate, Birth Certificate, Passport, or PAN Card.
  • Identity Proof (Max 70 KB PDF): Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Voter ID, Passport, or Driving License.
  • Address Proof (Max 70 KB PDF): Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, Ration Card, Passport, or Electricity Bill.
  • Affidavit (शपथ पत्र): Prescribed affidavit from both groom and bride (Max 200 KB PDF).
For Witnesses (2 Required)
  • Photograph: Passport size photo of witnesses (Max 40 KB, JPEG).
  • Identity Proof: (Max 70 KB PDF).
  • Address Proof: (Max 70 KB PDF).
  • Note: The first witness must be a blood relative (Mother, Father, Brother, Sister, etc.). The second witness can be any known person.
Marriage Proof
  • Certificate of Marriage Place: Issued by a religious authority/temple, local body, or Gazetted Officer.
To Carry for SRO Physical Visit
  • Printed online application form, online Payment Receipt, and Appointment Slip.
  • Originals and photocopies of all uploaded documents.
  • Extra passport-size photos and 2-3 Wedding Ceremony Photographs (e.g., Varmala/Jaimala).
onlineApplication:
Method 1: Online Application via IGRSUP Portal & SRO Physical Visit

The marriage registration process in Uttar Pradesh is hybrid. You must initiate the application online, pay the fee, book a slot, and then physically visit the Sub-Registrar Office (SRO) to complete registration.

Step-by-Step Process:
  1. Step 1 (User Registration): Go to the official IGRSUP portal (igrsup.gov.in). Under the 'विवाह पंजीकरण' (Marriage Registration) section, click on 'नवीन आवेदन प्रपत्र भरें'. Then click on 'नवीन आवेदन' to create an account. Choose a User ID, password, and verify your mobile number via OTP.
  2. Step 2 (Fill Couple's Details): Log in with your User ID. Fill in the Groom's and Bride's personal details, parents' names, date of birth, religion, and addresses. Note: Names must be entered in both English and Hindi. (Use Google Input Tools for Hindi typing if needed).
  3. Step 3 (Marriage Venue & Witnesses): Enter details of where and when the marriage was solemnized and the rites performed. Enter the names, relations, and addresses of the two witnesses.
  4. Step 4 (Office Selection & Appointment Booking): Select your District and the Sub-Registrar Office where you wish to register. Choose an available date (highlighted in green) from the calendar and select a time slot for your physical visit.
  5. Step 5 (Document Upload): Upload photographs, ID proofs, age proofs, address proofs, affidavits, and marriage proof for the couple and the witnesses in the exact file sizes requested.
  6. Step 6 (Review & Submit): Use the 'Preview' option to verify all details. Check the declaration box and click 'Final Submit'.
  7. Step 7 (Payment): Proceed to pay the marriage registration fee online using Net Banking, UPI, or Debit/Credit Card. Download the Payment Receipt.
  8. Step 8 (Print Documents): Download and print the Acknowledgement Slip, the Appointment Token, and the complete Application Form.
  9. Step 9 (Offline Physical Visit): On the date and time of your booked appointment, the husband, wife, and both witnesses must physically visit the selected Sub-Registrar Office. Submit the printed forms and photocopies. The SRO officials will verify original documents, take live photographs/biometrics, and collect physical signatures to complete the process.
offlineApplication:
Method 2: Assisted Offline Application (No Purely Manual Route)

Important: A purely manual offline form submission at the office is no longer supported. The application must be initiated online on the IGRSUP portal to ensure transparency.

If you cannot apply online yourself:
  1. Step 1 (Visit CSC): Visit your nearest Common Service Centre (CSC), Jan Seva Kendra, or a local cyber cafe.
  2. Step 2 (Assisted Data Entry): For a nominal service charge, the operator will fill out the online form on the IGRSUP portal, upload your documents, pay the fee, and book your SRO appointment slot.
  3. Step 3 (Office Verification): You, your spouse, and both witnesses must still physically visit the Sub-Registrar Office for the final original document verification and signature collection.
afterApplying:
After SRO Verification — Certificate Issuance

1. Legal Registration

After the successful verification of original documents and signature collection at the Sub-Registrar Office, the marriage is legally registered.

2. Certificate Collection

Depending on the workload of the SRO office, the finalized physical Marriage Certificate is either handed over to you on the same day or within a few working days.

3. Online Tracking & Download

You can track your application status or download the digitally signed Marriage Certificate directly from the IGRSUP portal (igrsup.gov.in) by logging in with your User ID.
